semantics: One line a b k, 1<=a,b,k<=10^6 and a<=b (10^6 confirmed from codeforces.me statement TeX). Unique integer: minimum l in 1..b-a+1 such that every window x..x+l-1 with a<=x<=b-l+1 holds at least k primes, else -1. Oracle takes the maximum over window starts a and p+1 (p prime) of min(k-th prime from x minus x plus 1, b-x+2); literal statement brute with trial division and a linear-sieve prefix-count binary search independently check it.
